question: Who among the following received the 'Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award' in 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rohit Sharma.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Batsman Rohit Sharma** was among the five athletes who had received the country's highest sporting honour, the **Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award, for 2020.**
 
• **Other winners in 2020:**
 
 
• Wrestler Vinesh Phogat
 
• Women's hockey captain Rani Rampal
 
• Table tennis star Manika Batra
 
• Para-athlete Mariyappan Thangavelu
 
 
 
• 12 sportspersons will be honoured with the Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award (former Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna) 2021.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• The Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award is India’s highest honour given for achievement in sports.
 
• The award was instituted in the year 1991- 92 and was awarded by the Government of India.
 
• Vishwanathan Anand was the first person to win the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna award.
 
• Manika Batra is the first table tennis player to win the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award.​
